context_summary: The paper proposes a three-layered framework using knowledge graphs for product design, integrating semantic automatic annotation and keyword extraction. A GAN-based knowledge recommendation model is developed to integrate user and problem context information. A case study on new energy vehicle design validates the framework's practicality.
